title: Fanout bound after sealing gates
statement: Fix $n\in\mathbb{N}$. Let $gs$ be an acyclic gate list, meaning that every argument index at position $i$ is less than $n+i$, and let $o<n+|gs|$. Let $L$ be a list of distinct indices, each less than $n+|gs|$, with $o\notin L$. Suppose every index in $L$ has fanout zero in $gs$, the fanout of $o$ in $gs$ is at most one, and every index has fanout at most two in $gs$. Then after sealing the indices in $L$ starting from $(gs,o)$, every index has fanout at most two in the resulting gate list.
hypotheses_covered: A gate list $gs$ acyclic relative to $n$
A list $L$ whose entries are less than $n+|gs|$
Every index in $L$ has fanout zero in $gs$
The fanout of $o$ in $gs$ is at most one
Every index has fanout at most two in $gs$
